d:
Platinum white hair, short and styled in a messy, layered cut with wispy bangs. Pale lavender eyes with a sleepy, heavy-lidded expression. Appears to be in their late teens with a youthful, soft face. Slender build, wearing a traditional Japanese-style outfit consisting of a white kimono with a wide purple obi and a matching purple haori. Features a singular, small, white horn protruding from the center of the forehead.
BODY COLOR: pale white
